| *Image long description:* 2 images one on top of the other comparing  |
| fractions with related denominators. The first fraction strip is      |

| 0 to 1 number line marked with quarters. The 2 images show that 3     |
| eighths is half of 3 quarters.\                                       |
| \                                                                     |
| Three-eighths is half of three-quarters so $$2\frac{3}{8}$$ is        |
| $$1\frac{5}{8}$$ more than three-quarters, as $$\frac{3}{8}$$ and     |
| $$\frac{5}{8}$$ make 1 whole.                                         |
